stats.title: Rule statistics for this cluster
stats.subtitle: How often each diagnostic rule was confirmed by people in this cluster. This is a hint for reading a report, not a verdict.
stats.scope: Based on {records} closed investigations with an explicit mark; {unevaluated} without one are not counted.
stats.note: Only what people marked is counted. Percentages appear once there are at least 5 cases; before that only the number of cases is shown.
stats.truncated: Only the most recent closed investigations are counted.
stats.fewCases: {m} cases so far: too few for a percentage
stats.previouslyUnhelpful: previously did not help here (helped in {n} of {m})
stats.exportInfo: Creates a JSON file with aggregates only: rule codes, counters, median times and coverage. It contains no resource names, namespaces, investigation IDs, notes, users, cluster or organisation identifiers, signatures or exact timestamps. Nothing is sent anywhere: sharing the file is your decision.
stats.exportConfirm: Export anonymous rule statistics to a file? It contains only rule codes and counters, with no names or notes. Nothing is sent automatically.

recurrence.title: This looks like a repeat
recurrence.summary: An earlier investigation of this problem was closed as “{result}” on {time}.
recurrence.summaryNoOutcome: An earlier investigation of this problem was opened on {time}.
recurrence.unavailable: It repeats an earlier investigation that is no longer available.
